name: Room post persisted as a Model Plane chat thread (origin=space, space_id)
notes: SRC. Gateway mints a Control thread:create decision and passes it to Model Gateway; Session Core enforces origin/space_id pairing via CHECK. Partial because every post is always an AI turn.

name: Human-only message (post without an AI reply)
notes: Searched the Spaces router, the room composer (only streamChat) and the chat router: no route posts a human message without a model invocation. Doc claims a human-only flow exists (doc-vs-code discrepancy).

name: Shared thread listing for all Space members (thread-read decision)
notes: SRC. Policy-gated by space_effect_policies; Control 403/404 degrades to owner-bound listing; gateway verifies every thread belongs to the Space. Present in source, not proven deployed.

name: Room transcript read "as the room" with audience-revision filtering
notes: SRC. Separate from owner-bound chat transcript; Session Core drops rows stamped with a newer audience revision than the decision. Policy-gated.

name: Reply into another member's thread (shared append)
notes: SRC. Gateway mints digest-bound thread:append decision, but Session Core append_message still calls authorize_thread_owner(Mutate), so non-owner replies are refused. UI still offers Reply.

name: Mid-stream steer / queued input
notes: SRC. Re-mints the append decision per queued message.

name: Stop / cancel a running turn
notes: SRC. Composer aborts SSE then calls cancel; run flips to cancelled.

name: Author attribution per turn (human subject and agent name)
notes: SRC. author_subject_id from verified caller only, never from request.

name: Retitle / pin a post
notes: SRC. Owner-only: non-owner gets thread_presentation_owner_only. Pinned threads sort first. Space-authorized presentation write is planned.

name: @agent mention invokes a bound agent (server re-resolves roster and binding)
notes: SRC. Browser sends only mentioned_agent_ref (Control subject id); gateway intersects Control roster with Application binding and injects agent_name/system prompt.

name: @person mention
notes: SRC. Text insertion only; no server-side mention record and no notification (notification allowlist blocks it).

name: Markdown / code / citation rendering in room
notes: SRC. Frontend reuses ChatMarkdown; listed because the backend stream carries markdown and citations.

name: Edit or delete a single message
notes: Searched Model Plane proto for EditMessage|UpdateMessage|edit_message: no hits. Spaces router has no message delete route. Only whole-thread DELETE /v1/threads/:id for the owner via Chat.

name: Reactions / emoji
notes: Searched "reaction" and "emoji" in session-core src and migrations and in gateway spaces.rs: none.

name: Attachments / link previews in room
notes: Searched attach|upload|file in the room composer and Spaces router: none. Chat has /api/v1/chat/documents but the room does not use it.

name: Presence and typing indicators
notes: SRC. POST /spaces/{ref}/presence (online|typing|offline); caller writes only own row; TTL 30 s, typing decays after 8 s; no content in rows. Delivered by polling, not push.

name: Read state (room-level last-read marker)
notes: SRC. Per-member lastReadAt only; unread derived client-side; no per-thread or per-message read receipts.

name: DMs / group DMs
notes: Searched Space kinds: only personal, room, project, case; create accepts only personal and room. No DM kind or route.

name: Drafts, scheduled send, polls, forwarding, voice clips, saved items
notes: Searched Spaces router, Convex schema and session-core migrations for draft|schedule_send|poll|forward|voice|saved|bookmark: no Space hits. Inbox drafts exist only for support conversations.

name: Space aggregate with lifecycle and Control registration outbox
notes: SRC. Lifecycle pending_registration|active|suspended|deleting|deleted|failed_registration; unusable until Control acks; create returns 202.

name: Control membership, roles and authority revisions
notes: SRC. registered_spaces, space_authority_revisions, space_memberships (subject_type user|service; roles viewer|editor|manager|owner).

name: Space listing (Control index intersected with Application labels)
notes: SRC. If Control is unavailable, only the personal Space is shown.

name: Organization room (#general) with org-roster sync
notes: SRC. Idempotent ensure; roster from active org members as editor; sync on registration ack. syncAllOrganizationRooms has no caller and no crons.ts exists (INF: later roster changes not auto-synced).

name: Create a named room
notes: SRC. Any active org member; creator becomes registration owner.

name: Add / remove a person in a room
notes: SRC. Owner/manager only; managed_subject_types ["user"] so human roster changes cannot remove agents; grants always editor; personal Space and org room refused.

name: Change a member's room role
notes: Searched Spaces router for role update routes: none. Grant role is v.literal("editor").

name: Roster read (proxy to Control)
notes: SRC. Non-member gets 404.

name: Personal Space (one per principal)
notes: SRC. by_personal_owner index plus ensure mutation.

name: Project / case Spaces
notes: SRC. Control and Convex schema accept the kinds, but the gateway refuses creating anything other than personal or room.

name: Guests / external users / shared channels
notes: Searched membership sources: rosters come only from active org members or manually added org members. External identity link is only an ADR (S5.1).

name: Room discovery / browse / self-join
notes: Searched Spaces router for browse|join|public routes: none. Listing shows only Spaces in the caller's Control index.

name: Org members, invites, org roles and RBAC catalog
notes: SRC. Org-level only, not room-level.

name: Teams / sub-groups inside an org
notes: Searched org-core Go for "team": no hits. conversation-core ticket teams are support routing only.

name: Room deletion
notes: SRC. Only personal Spaces can be deleted; Control rejects non-personal deletion.

name: Audio / video calls, huddles, screen share between members
notes: Searched gateway router list and Model/Application planes for call|huddle|webrtc|livekit|meeting routes: none. Channel Plane is docs-only.

name: Remote desktop assistance (RustDesk config)
notes: SRC. Gateway serves only config; sessions go browser to hbbs/hbbr and never pass through the gateway; no durable session or audit record. Not a Space feature.

name: Meeting transcription / recap / minutes
notes: DOC. WhisperX ASR, keyframes and wiki minutes in phased plan; no code.

name: AI realtime voice (Model Gateway)
notes: SRC. /v1/ai/realtime* exists for human-to-AI voice; not a human call and not Space-scoped.

name: Calendar / meeting scheduling
notes: Searched gateway domains for calendar|meeting scheduling: none. Only agent cron schedules exist.

name: Space Knowledge tab (documents + wiki bound to the Space)
notes: SRC. Control retrieval.read decision feeds Data Plane /v1/knowledge/space-sources. DOC: no import writes space_ref yet, so lists are empty in practice.

name: Grounded room turns (Space retrieval)
notes: SRC. Separate retrieval_read_entitled bit; 403 degrades the turn to ungrounded. Policy-gated.

name: Search messages / threads in a Space
notes: Searched gateway for Space/thread search routes: search.rs is web/image/video only; conversation search exists only for the support inbox.

name: People directory
notes: SRC. Per-Space roster plus org members list; no cross-org directory.

name: Org-wide agent registry ("installations")
notes: SRC. One Convex query grouped by definition; answers presence, not authority.

name: Notification feed / unread count / preferences (notification-core proxy)
notes: SRC. Proxy exists; Novu delivery mode disabled by default and delivery worker off (DOC).

name: Notifications from Space events (mention, reply, approval needed, room invite)
notes: Searched notification-core producer allowlist: gateway may send only notification.created to itself; capability-core only run_completed/run_failed. mention.received is seeded but has no producer.

name: Notify me when a run finishes (run watchers)
notes: SRC. Per user, not per room.

name: Space watches (S4.3)
notes: SRC. capability-core create/list/cancel with Control watch-create/observe decisions, TTL 8 h (max 7 d), max 8 per Space, process-output adapter. Not exposed via Model Gateway or Verevon gateway; Activity reports watches_not_built.

name: Space Activity feed (runs, approvals, owner receipts, named gaps)
notes: SRC. Runs (limit 100), awaiting_approval approvals (max 10), owner effect receipts and authorizing grants; named gaps for delivery and watches.

name: Unread badges
notes: SRC. Room-level for the open room only; no cross-room aggregate in sidebar.

name: Mute / DND / quiet hours / digest
notes: Searched Spaces router and Convex schema for mute|dnd|quiet|digest: none. Only per-event/channel preferences in notification-core. Quiet hours planned in S4.4.

name: Durable Space delivery ledger (S4.4)
notes: SRC named gap delivery_ledger_not_built.

name: Mobile / desktop push delivery
notes: DOC. Novu adapter in source, disabled by default; provider-side ZDR not proven.

name: AI-first action registry for Spaces (14 spaces.* actions)
notes: SRC. Gateway dispatches; drift guard checks registry/dispatcher parity.

name: / skill picker in room (skill_ids resolved server-side)
notes: SRC.

name: Owner agent-action grants (tickets.create)
notes: SRC. Org owner/admin requests owner-grant decision forwarded to Conversation Core; only tickets.create correlated.

name: Delivery targets on bindings (Teams, Messenger, embed)
notes: SRC. Schema field and internal mutation only; no adapter.

name: External surfaces (Slack / Teams mirror)

notes: SRC. Exists in Model Gateway but not Space-scoped; Space MCP cockpit planned (S3.6).

name: AG-UI protocol stream with Space persona/authority injection
notes: SRC.

notes: SRC. Control-first join: unnamed but authorized agent shown, unauthorized binding dropped.

notes: SRC. Definition + pending binding, then Control service roster declared and set active. Owner/manager; name 2-60 chars, instructions up to 4,000.

name: Bind an existing agent definition to a room
notes: SRC.

notes: SRC. Revoke re-converges the Control roster.

name: Authored instruction hierarchy (platform > org > Space > user > agent)
notes: SRC. Editor+ writes Space instructions (max 4,000 chars); client-supplied values stripped; no versioning.

name: Personal agents (per-user, Grok-style)
notes: Searched personal-Space agent binding paths: Control refuses personal membership replacement and requireManagedRoom refuses personal Spaces; agents exist only in shared rooms.

name: In-room approvals (approve / deny)
notes: SRC. decided_by pinned to caller; org-scoped. Granted approval recorded but continuation quarantined (no resume on this path); deny cancels; no approval scopes.

name: Work projection (runs, schedules, background processes)

name: Memory scoped per room
